description: Standard operating procedure for aspirating reagent from a beaker and dispensing into a conical flask.

steps.title: Acquire pipette
steps.instruction: Grasp the micropipette from the instrument holster.
steps.voice_message: Step one. Please pick up the pipette.

steps.title: Position pipette over beaker
steps.instruction: Lower pipette tip into beaker to aspirate reagent solution.
steps.voice_message: Position the pipette tip inside the reagent beaker.

steps.title: Transfer solution to conical flask
steps.instruction: Dispense solution into target conical flask.
steps.voice_message: Dispense the solution carefully into the conical flask.

steps.title: Return pipette to holster
steps.instruction: Return pipette to holster and release grip.
steps.voice_message: Return the pipette to its holder and release.
